messages:
alex: quick q — running into a weird auth header issue when reading API keys in Node + GH Actions. local works, CI sends header with an extra char and calls fail with 401 when streaming. anyone seen this? :thinking:

maria: is it newline related? GH actions runners sometimes add \n if you cat a file or use actions/checkout with secrets. what does your header look like?

alex: i build the header like this in the workflow: `echo ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_KEY }} | base64` and then `Authorization: Basic <that>` in the request. locally i do `echo -n $KEY | base64` — difference probably obvious but wanted to confirm.

sam: yep echo vs echo -n. GH actions `echo` is sh on linux, usually adds a trailing \n. use `printf '%s' \"$KEY\" | base64` or `echo -n` to avoid the newline.

lucy: also watch Windows runners and PowerShell — `Get-Content secret.txt` adds line endings sometimes. for ps you can do `(Get-Content .secret -Raw).Trim()` or `-Raw` plus `Trim()` to remove \r\n.

alex: ok trying `printf` now. curious — why does a newline break streaming but not simple generation calls?

sam: streaming often validates auth during the websocket/stream handshake; an extra byte changes the base64 decode so backend sees wrong credentials — silent 401 on the stream setup. non-stream endpoints might treat header differently or your client might retry differently.

maria: small tip: in node you can do `const header = 'Basic ' + Buffer.from(key.trim()).toString('base64')` — that handles stray whitespace/newlines.

alex: here's a minimal repro i had in node:```js
const key = require('fs').readFileSync('.secret').toString();
const h = 'Basic ' + Buffer.from(key).toString('base64');
console.log(h); // ends up with extra \n base64
```

lucy: replace with `toString().trim()` or `readFileSync('.secret', 'utf8').replace(/\r|\n/g, '')` if you expect files with CRLF.

alex: thanks — switching to trim fixes CI. one more oddity: when i put the key in .env as `REDWOOD_KEY=\"s3cret\"` and use `process.env.REDWOOD_KEY` node yields quotes included. anyone seen that trap?

maria: yep — dotenv doesn't strip quotes. define as `REDWOOD_KEY=s3cret` or strip in code: `process.env.REDWOOD_KEY?.replace(/^\"|\"$/g, '')`.

devex-eng: internal note: doc suggestion — add a small snippet to devex quickstart about safe env reading, showing printf/trim/Buffer.from handling for different runners. filing a tiny PR after this thread. :memo:

alex: one last misc thing — base64 CLI flags differ: `base64 -w0` vs mac `base64` no wrap. GH actions uses ubuntu so `base64 -w0` is safe. just throwing that out there in case people paste examples that wrap lines.

sam: good point. `base64 | tr -d '\\n'` is portable.

infra-bot: reminder: rotate key if you think it got logged by accidental `echo` in workflow. see infra/security/keys policy.

alex: all good now, thanks everyone :tada:
